summary: MTN MoMo switch from /public/payments/transfer to /public/payments/debit-credit VERIFIED. Called POST /api/billing/momo/initiate with plan basic_monthly + real MTN number 250794230137: response returned 200 with reference='bbfm-9f66f8911f1243ab', besoftTxId='9b688dfb-1226-4e3b-bb3a-bc32fbd071e9' and status='failed' (as expected — MTN provider returned HTTP_400 'account inactive', which is a payer-side issue, not a code issue). Inspected Mongo db.payments (latest) and confirmed besoftPayload.debit.metadata.kind === 'debit_credit' and metadata.credits has exactly ONE entry with payee_identifier='250798875272' and amount=1000 — proving the debit-credit endpoint received the correct payload. Regression: OTP verify with 123456 ✓, /api/radio/now-playing returns youtubeVideoId='wPD77ygQKfo' ✓, /api/shows returns 6 items ✓, PayPal create-subscription returns approveUrl with 'paypal.com' ✓, MoMo status polling returns status field ✓. Frontend regression on Expo web (mobile viewport 390x844): onboarding-skip → phone-continue → 6-digit OTP fill → auto-navigate to home → tab-profile → upgrade-btn → paywall (period-monthly/yearly toggles + plan-basic) → paywall-continue → checkout shows all 4 methods (paypal, mtn_momo, airtel, stripe) with momo-phone-input visible on MTN MoMo, 'currently mocked' banner on Airtel+Stripe, and 'Live PayPal' badge on PayPal. 6/6 backend pytest cases green.
